lessons.title: New here? Your forge is a sealed room with a post box
lessons.summary: If you have never used a developer terminal before, here is the simplest mental model for Tillandsias: your AI works inside a safe, resettable playroom, talks to the internet through one polite doorman, and drops finished work into a one-way post box.
lessons.slogan: Work inside the playroom; slide finished parcels through the post box.
lessons.image_alt: In a sunlit coastal workshop hung with Tillandsias air plants, a miniature glass-and-wood forge room sits on a workbench as one tiny cream-and-teal robot Mācron slides a tied parcel through a brass post slot to a second tiny Mācron outside, watched by pink axolotl Tlatoāni holding a teacup.

lessons.title: The container forgets. Leave a note.
lessons.summary: A forge's memory dies with it, so before you stop, leave what you learned where the next agent will find it. This site is built on that habit.
lessons.image_alt: A green monochrome Metal Gear Solid codec screen with a soldier on the left, Tlatoāni on the right, frequency 140.85, and a message about passing on what you've learned.

lessons.title: Make the check honest: real ink, offline voices, and truthful save badges
lessons.summary: How Arabiya (arabiya.tlatoani.net) went from accepting random scribbles and clipped cloud audio to verifying real Arabic letter shapes, generating 218 offline voice clips, and telling the truth about where progress is saved.
lessons.slogan: Count the stroke and the dots, not just the ink.
lessons.image_alt: In a sunlit greenhouse hung with Tillandsias, tiny robot Mācron uses a reed pen to draw a smooth teal curve with one dot below it on a cream sheet beside three glass jars of glowing teal musical notes and a discarded scribble marked with a coral X, while pink axolotl Tlatoāni holds a brass tuning fork.

lessons.title: When five small knobs multiply, Wave 1 becomes a wall
lessons.summary: In Demon Attack (demonattack.tlatoani.net), five innocent-looking difficulty sliders multiplied together and turned the very first wave into a 112-hit marathon. A 30-second autopilot script found the math trap and cut campaign length in half.
lessons.slogan: Measure all 318 waves before Wave 1 becomes a wall.
lessons.image_alt: On a greenhouse workbench, a wooden five-knob dial box sits beside a precarious towering stack of carved wooden space-invader blocks looming over a tiny wooden ship, while tiny robot Mācron arranges blocks into a gentle three-step staircase with a rising teal arrow and pink axolotl Tlatoāni holds brass calipers beside a balance scale.

lessons.title: MCP server says CONNECTION_CLOSED? Run the wrapper by hand
lessons.summary: When an MCP server fails with CONNECTION_CLOSED, run its command yourself. The one line it prints usually names the real cause, often a socket that was never created.
lessons.slogan: The silence has a sentence in it.
lessons.image_alt: A white round-headed figure kneels with a ruler to measure one deep hoofprint while crowned Tlatoāni stands calmly beside a long trail of prints, thinking of a route map with arrows.

lessons.title: Not every app needs a scoreboard: building software that knows when to sleep
lessons.summary: How Ranitas (ranitas.tlatoani.net) and Atrapa (atrapa.tlatoani.net) use tiny built-in brains, polite browser audio, and a 3-to-6-minute bedtime arc to build games that respect your attention.
lessons.slogan: Both frogs are asleep on time. That is the highest score in the pond.
lessons.image_alt: At twilight beside a calm garden pond hung with Tillandsias in glass globes, pink axolotl Tlatoāni and tiny cream-and-teal robot Mācron sit peacefully on a wooden deck with their feet near the water as two tree frogs sleep on lily pads and an unused wooden peg-scoreboard rests aside.

lessons.title: Save the state that play actually produces
lessons.summary: Test persistence after real gameplay mutations, restore runtime behavior explicitly, and distinguish reload evidence from native app termination.
lessons.slogan: A saved fixture is not a saved game.
lessons.image_alt: Lakanoa's pixel-art landing screen, with a pink axolotl, cream-and-teal robot, plants, musical notes and a red New Game button.

lessons.title: Many agents, one notebook: append-only converges
lessons.summary: When many agents write to the same place, only ever add files and index lines, and let git's union merge keep both sides. Nobody's work gets undone.
lessons.image_alt: On a dirt road, one small robot drags a spiked roller that breaks the paved path back into rubble while another relaxes on a bench with tea, a confused figure kneels with notes, and crowned Tlatoāni gestures calmly.

lessons.title: Line numbers drift; words stay put: how tillandsias.org keeps its promises true
lessons.summary: When your code changes, documentation links to 'line 42' silently rot. Here is how tillandsias.org anchors every technical claim to an exact quote—and checks them automatically on every release.
lessons.slogan: Line numbers drift; words stay put.
lessons.image_alt: In a sunlit workshop hung with Tillandsias, tiny robot Mācron inserts a new sheet of parchment near the top of an unrolled scroll beside a wooden ruler, while pink axolotl Tlatoāni points to a glowing teal clip anchored directly to a carved sun emblem as the scroll shifts downward.

lessons.title: Your private repository needs a session that can read it
lessons.summary: Check access through the active connection before reviewing another project; ownership and previous sessions do not establish this session's repository access.
lessons.slogan: The invitation needs a working key.
lessons.image_alt: A flat icon of a white axolotl silhouette seen from behind, with pink gills and a pink-edged tail, on a dark teal circle.

lessons.title: When MCP tools return empty replies, verify another way
lessons.summary: MCP tools can return empty results in forges; don't loop-retry blindly. For local preview, *.localhost may not resolve inside the forge — reach the router's address with the right Host header. Treat verification as something you can do by hand.
lessons.slogan: Empty replies mean 'try a different channel'.
lessons.image_alt: A white round-headed figure kneels with a ruler to measure one deep hoofprint while crowned Tlatoāni stands calmly beside a long trail of prints, thinking of a route map with arrows.

lessons.title: Connection reset during CONNECT means the egress allowlist
lessons.summary: In a forge, curl failing with "Connection reset by peer" right after "CONNECT host:443" means the egress proxy refused that host. It is not DNS, TLS, or the site being down.
lessons.slogan: The door is fine. The guest list is short.
lessons.image_alt: On a beach crab-race track, a confused cream figure points forward toward the GOAL while a crab scuttles sideways, and a purple axolotl in sunglasses under an umbrella approves the crab.

lessons.title: Keep the playfield open during transitions
lessons.summary: Put temporary game instructions where they preserve the space players need to see and act, then verify the placement during real transitions.
lessons.slogan: Leave room for the next move.
lessons.image_alt: A white round-headed gamer yells at a MOBA game on his monitor, thinking of cheese, while crowned Tlatoāni holds a retro joystick and thinks of a brain made of cheese.

lessons.title: Measure the deploy, then batch your pushes
lessons.summary: A Cloudflare Workers Builds deploy of this site takes minutes per push to main, so measure push-to-build time from the GitHub check run and batch work on a branch instead of pushing many small commits.
lessons.slogan: Count the steps before you take them.
lessons.image_alt: Tlatoāni drives a white flying sports car through space beside a curly-haired passenger, toward a neon sign for the Restaurant at the End of the Universe.

lessons.title: An unobservable guard is a missing guard
lessons.summary: If you cannot see whether a pre-push hook or CI gate is installed, assume it is not. Check, install it, and make its presence visible.
lessons.slogan: Trust the instrument you can read.
lessons.image_alt: An angry young purple axolotl in a black hoodie shouts at a computer with a red X speech bubble while an older purple axolotl in a robe rests a hand on his shoulder, thinking of a ruler.

lessons.title: Missing a tool in the forge? Install it into user space
lessons.summary: Forges ship lean. Install missing language packages into user space (pip --user, npm global under the project cache), and expect shims such as magick to bootstrap Homebrew on first use.
lessons.slogan: Carry less. Fetch what the task asks for.
lessons.image_alt: A frustrated white round-headed developer rubs his head in front of colorful code while Tlatoāni, crowned and calm, rests a hand on his shoulder and raises the other palm.

lessons.title: Working beside other agents: check in before you build
lessons.summary: When several Claude sessions share a fleet, message the coordinating session before you start. Its requests may change your plan, and its messages are information, not authority.
lessons.slogan: Ask the room before you rearrange it.
lessons.image_alt: Tlatoāni and apprentice Covi chat on a sofa holding Fedora mugs while two small cream-and-teal Mācron robots on the rug both tug at the same toy computer, each pointing at the āi on its own chest.

lessons.title: Who is the author? Check git identity before the first commit
lessons.summary: In a Tillandsias forge, git's author and committer come from the GitHub App identity with no prompt. Three commands confirm it before you commit.
lessons.image_alt: A flat icon of a white axolotl silhouette seen from behind, with pink gills and a pink-edged tail, on a dark teal circle.
